file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, stripped, 10 sections

injection_details.method: OpenProcess(0x42A = PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD|PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION) -> VirtualAllocEx(MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE 0x3000, PAGE_READWRITE) -> WriteProcessMemory(decoded DLL path, strlen+1) -> CreateRemoteThread(start = LoadLibraryA, param = remote buffer) -> WaitForSingleObject(thread, INFINITE) -> CloseHandle
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS=2), then Process32First/Process32Next loop comparing PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile (offset 0x2c) against "explorer.exe" via strcmp; matching th32ProcessID is opened
injection_details.payload_write: The 32-byte XOR-decoded string from .data is written into remotely allocated PAGE_READWRITE memory in explorer.exe and used as the argument to LoadLibraryA (classic CreateRemoteThread DLL injection)
injection_details.api_resolution: Only GetModuleHandleA is imported; all injection APIs (CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject, LoadLibraryA) are resolved at runtime by a custom export-table parser (manual GetProcAddress at 0x1400014ef) walking kernel32.dll's export directory

encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded as the first 8 bytes of the .rdata section (VA 0x140004000), immediately before the plaintext "kernel32.dll" string; the 32-byte ciphertext blob is in .data at VA 0x140003000 and is copied to the stack before in-place decryption

decoded_strings.note: This 32-byte decoded value is passed to LoadLibraryA in explorer.exe as the DLL path. API/target strings stored in plaintext in .rdata (not encrypted): kernel32.dll, CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject, explorer.exe, LoadLibraryA

anti_analysis: PEB anti-debug: reads PEB via gs:[0x60] and tests the BeingDebugged byte at PEB+2 (function 0x14000163f); main returns 0 immediately without injecting when a debugger is present

Minimal import table / API hiding: injection-related APIs are not imported; resolved at runtime via a custom PE export-table parser (no GetProcAddress import), so static import analysis only shows benign CRT/KERNEL32 entries
XOR-obfuscated payload DLL path stored in .data, decrypted only at runtime
